subject: POC add-on slab vs ratecard — bridge decision
messages:
From: Samir Desai <samir@lumenai.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — POC run-rate spike and short extension?

Hi Vivek / Marissa,

Quick context: we blew through expected token run-rate in week 2 of the POC (attached sample usage). Engineering still needs the extra 2 weeks to finish the integration tests and a small offline eval. Can Redwood do either:

- a short 14-day add-on slab (buy X tokens at a set rate as a one-off) OR
- extend the POC timeline by 14 days and get incremental usage billed at a discounted rate (we're a flat-rate evaluation today)

Procurement is on this thread (procurement@lumenai.com) and will need any formal quote. We prefer a clean path — either a fixed add-on we can PO now, or a short extension with an invoice.

Also: we want the billing to remain separate from our main account (can't convert this to commit yet).

Attachments: poc_usage_week2.csv (CSV - sample usage)

Thanks,
Samir Desai
Senior ML Product Manager
LumenAI
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Desai <samir@lumenai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — POC run-rate spike and short extension?

Samir,

Appreciate the heads up and the usage file — that's helpful. Two practical options we can move on quickly:

1) Add-on slab (recommended for speed):
   - 14-day slab: +1M tokens at $0.008/token (one-time invoice)
   - Includes preserved KV cache for the POC model variant (keeps latency profile)
   - No change to current account conversion options

2) Timebox extension with conditional discount:
   - Extend POC by 14 days; incremental usage billed at $0.010/token with a 10% discount applied to that period if PO received within 48 hrs

If procurement can issue a PO for option 1 we can provision same-day. I attached a short draft of the proposed bridge terms to make approvals easier. If you'd like, Marissa can map success metrics we expect to see during the extended window.

Attachments: proposed-bridge-term-v1.pdf (PDF - proposed short bridge SOW)

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Desai <samir@lumenai.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — POC run-rate spike and short extension?

Samir — quick operational notes from CS:

- We want to lock in two success checks during the 14-day window (integration test pass + 95th percentile latency check) so we can avoid scope creep.
- Suggest adding a small ‘burst-insurance’ credit (e.g., 100k tokens) that we do not bill unless you exceed the slab; this is useful to avoid repeated amends.
- If option 2 (timebox+discount), we'll need a clear start/end timestamp and a PO or email approval to apply the 10% discount.

I uploaded a one-page SOW draft with the two milestones. If procurement needs a line-item breakdown, Vivek can share the price table.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Procurement Team <procurement@lumenai.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — POC run-rate spike and short extension?

Hi Vivek / Marissa,

Thanks for options. A few formal requests from procurement before we can issue a PO:

- Can you provide a fixed cap option (max $) rather than open-ended token pricing? We prefer a single invoice.
- Net 30 payment terms and standard Redwood T&Cs (we'll redline if required).
- LumenAI asks for a 25% discount on any additional consumption during trials (this has been our internal policy with other vendors).

If you can return a simple one-page quote with line items, we'll circulate it for approval.

Procurement
LumenAI
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@lumenai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — POC run-rate spike and short extension?

Thanks — quick reply on the asks:

- Fixed cap: we can do a capped add-on invoice. Example: $8,000 fixed cap for the 14-day slab (covers up to 1M tokens). If you exceed that cap we’ll notify you and pause additional usage until an amendment is approved.
- Terms: Net 30 is fine.
- Discount: we can't meet 25% on one-off trial top-ups. We can offer either: 1) 15% discount on additional consumption if LumenAI signs a 3-month paid pilot commit (min $25k) OR 2) 5% discount on the standalone slab if procurement issues PO within 48 hours.

If you want the 15% commit path I can route a short amendment (SOW + invoice) and prioritize provisioning. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/LUM-4987.

Attachments: sow-draft-lumenia.docx (DOCX - SOW draft)

— Vivek
From: Samir Desai <samir@lumenai.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@lumenai.com, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — POC run-rate spike and short extension?

Thanks Vivek — that framing helps.

We are going to take the 15% path and try to get an internal sign-off for the 3-month paid pilot commit. Procurement is looped on approvals — if they get the commit request approved we will issue a PO.

Can you send the 3-month amendment + invoice and a one-page SOW (finalized) so procurement has what they need? We should be able to get a decision by end of week.
